model_call_location: The model runs ONLY inside the host process (app/agent/core/loop.py), never inside ingredient_server.py - this server has zero imports of app.rag or any generation code, it only serves lookup_ingredient over its own static dataset.

field_annotations.id: correlates a response to its request; notifications (no id) get no reply
field_annotations.method: the JSON-RPC method name: initialize, tools/list, or tools/call
field_annotations.params.protocolVersion: MCP protocol version the client speaks
field_annotations.params.capabilities: client-advertised capabilities (empty here - this script is a raw probe, not a full client)
field_annotations.params.clientInfo: identifies the calling client for the server's logs
field_annotations.params.name: (tools/call) which tool to invoke
field_annotations.params.arguments: (tools/call) the tool's input arguments as a JSON object
field_annotations.result.tools: (tools/list response) the array of {name, description, inputSchema} the server exposes
field_annotations.result.content: (tools/call response) the tool's return value, wrapped as MCP content blocks

tools.name: lookup_ingredient
tools.description:
Looks up allergen flags and per-100g nutrition for one named ingredient
in the third-party ingredient database. If no exact match, returns a
suggestion for the closest known ingredient name instead of a bare error.
